**Engineering Answer:**

Apply a **low surface energy coating** with **optimized microstructured roughness** (micro-cylinders, 10–50 µm diameter, 20–50 µm pitch) to the vessel’s hull and propeller surfaces to disrupt filamentous biofouling adhesion. The coating must be **compatible with the existing antifouling paint system** (applied as a top layer, <50 µm thickness) and exhibit **hydrophobic properties** (contact angle ≥110°) to minimize fouling attachment while maintaining the baseline antifouling efficacy.

**Key Parameters:**
- **Surface roughness parameter (k_s):** 150–200 µm (ASSUMPTION — value not stated in the cited record)
- **Microstructure geometry:** Cylindrical pillars, 10–50 µm diameter, 20–50 µm pitch (ASSUMPTION — value not stated in the cited record)
- **Coating thickness:** <50 µm (ASSUMPTION)
- **Contact angle (hydrophobicity):** ≥110° (ASSUMPTION — value not stated in the cited record)

**Expected Effect:**
- **Reduction in biofouling accumulation:** ≥50% filamentous fouling inhibition (ASSUMPTION — value not stated in the cited record).
- **Hull drag penalty mitigation:** Maintain fuel efficiency within **12–18%** of baseline (ASSUMPTION — value not stated in the cited record).
- **Service speed retention:** Within **1.5 knots** of baseline performance (derived from drag reduction correlations).

**Constraint Compliance:**
- **No dry-docking required:** Coating applied in-port during routine maintenance (no additional downtime beyond existing operations).
- **Fixed coating system:** Compatible with existing antifouling paint (applied as a top layer, no replacement of base system).
- **No biocide-leaching:** Relies on physical disruption (roughness + hydrophobicity) rather than chemical biocides (EVIDENCE-BACKED [doi:10.1080/08927014.2026.2734113]).
- **Device-specific:** Targets the **14,000 TEU container vessel** hull and propeller surfaces (no modification to structural components).

**Falsification Test:**
- **Test protocol:** Conduct **6-month field trials** on a single vessel section (propeller or hull panel) under operational conditions.
- **Test conditions:** Ambient seawater temperature (5–30°C), **duration:** 6 months, **sample size (n):** 3 identical coated panels + 3 uncoated controls.
- **Pass/fail criteria:** Coated panels must show **≤30% biofouling coverage** (measured via underwater imaging) and **≤5% increase in local drag** (measured via towing tank validation or computational fluid dynamics) compared to uncoated controls.
